<!--
The most valuable bugs here are the SILENT ones: the map draws, `check` passes,
and the result is not what the document says. If you cannot point at something
visibly broken, that is not a reason to skip filing — it is usually the reason
it is worth filing.
-->

## What happens

<!-- What the tool does. If it does nothing at all, say so — that IS the bug. -->

## What should happen

<!-- Cite the spec section if you can find it. If you cannot, say what you expected
     and why; a rule nobody can locate is its own finding. -->

## How you checked

<!-- The step that separates "this looks wrong" from a report someone can act on.
     A diff of two renders, a measurement, a comparison against a reference — whatever
     told you. If you only noticed by eye, say that; it is still worth knowing. -->
